capabilities: mirror CalDAV events, tasks and CardDAV contacts as notes on an interval
write changes back through diff-previewing forms with undo
sync task notes with the server, resolving conflicts per row
match and adopt existing contact or event notes
expose a versioned read/write API for other plugins
disambiguation: Not a calendar or task manager; it only mirrors server data as notes and writes back through explicit, diff-confirmed commands.
extras: Not yet verified against mailbox.org or Nextcloud live servers; tested only against Radicale. No telemetry; passwords stored in Obsidian's secret storage. The manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Calendar events, tasks and contacts live on a DAV server outside the vault, so they cannot be linked, queried or edited from Obsidian.

relations.evidence: frontmatter, written the way TaskNotes expects it
mailbox.org or Nextcloud are the intended targets

requires.name: CalDAV/CardDAV server over HTTPS with Basic Auth
a mail plugin that registers itself with calendar-notes

summary: Mirrors CalDAV events, tasks and CardDAV contacts as Markdown notes with the server as source of truth; writes go back only via confirmed commands.
